wintercity_e07_entry.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_entry.text: On Day 857, Yue reached the public rig before its working day began. The floor was dry, the rear passage clear, and the uncharged model stood in its marked position. Yan asked her to describe the orientation without touching a lever. Yue followed the return path from the diagram to the model, then identified the ordinary isolation handle. Rehearsal began with an ordinary correct answer, not with a demonstration of how much reserve she could spend to make a doubtful movement look assured.

wintercity_e07_002.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_002.text: Yan turned the model around. The handle now lay on the other side of Yue's body, though its role had not changed. Yue paused before pointing. She remembered the earlier mistaken explanation and did not rush to cover it with speed. The correct sequence required isolation before a safe grounded release under the stated conditions. It could not be replaced by a single attractive gesture. She practised the steps slowly, stopping when Yan covered the indicator that a powered task might later make unreliable.

wintercity_e07_003.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_003.text: The model had no charge. Moving its lever neither spent personal qi nor accomplished a powered output. Yue wrote that fact on the lesson sheet. The sheet recorded what she had actually rehearsed: finding the ordinary controls under changed orientation and explaining the response to a false indicator. It did not certify a completed coupled task. Yan signed the bounded lesson only after Yue repeated it without relying on the uncovered diagram. They left the model in its proper neutral position.

wintercity_e07_004.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_004.text: Outside, the city's returned main made a quiet clicking sound beneath one pavement section. Yi's monitoring team had already inspected it and posted the current result. Yue could hear the sound without deciding it proved a hidden impending failure. The public notice named the contact for a changed sound, and she asked whether today's clicking matched the inspected observation. The keeper said it did. She noted the answer's date and continued walking rather than convert uncertainty into a rumour that would outrun the actual check.

wintercity_e07_005.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_005.text: At the fruit-tree path, the gardener was pruning a branch split by wet snow. He chose a cut that removed more than the visible crack because the damaged fibres extended farther. Yue held the fallen section after it was down, keeping it out of the passage. The gardener did not promise fruit from that branch next season. The tree would keep the remaining limbs, and the lost one would become ordinary fuel after drying. Repair could preserve a living thing without pretending nothing had been removed.

wintercity_e07_006.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_006.text: She asked whether the city trees were spiritually cultivated. He said some nursery work used inspected assistance, but these trees needed ordinary soil, water, pruning, and time. A technique could alter a particular process under its conditions; it could not substitute for every season. Yue had known the general rule and still liked hearing it beside the cut branch. The gardener asked her to put the light twigs in one pile. She finished that task, then went to buy lunch.

wintercity_e07_007.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_007.text: Wen joined her at the noodle stall, carrying an umbrella frame without its covering. The metal looked bare and a little absurd. Wen wanted the client to inspect the handle repair before she put the cloth back. That order could spare a second dismantling if the winter glove still caught. Yue admired how a task could be made reversible before it became expensive. Her own rig rehearsal had the same practical virtue, though its source of risk was different. They ate before the client arrived.

wintercity_e07_008.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_008.text: The client tried the repaired handle with his actual glove. It worked better, but one edge still rubbed. Wen marked that edge and offered the remaining agreed adjustment. The client approved the mark, not a vaguely improved future object. Yue watched from the side without commenting. She could hold the frame if asked; she could not replace the client's experience of his own hand. When they left, Wen said she was glad to have tested it before rebuilding the cover.

wintercity_e07_009.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_009.text: After lunch on Day 857, Yue visited an ordinary practice yard advertised beside the public baths. Its instructor, Min Tuan, taught safe steps and falls to porters and beginners. The sign claimed no spiritual examination. Yue paid the two-copper visitor fee and asked to observe before joining. Tuan showed her the padded low platform and the rule against carrying an unfamiliar heavy load during a first lesson. Ordinary practice could have rigorous limits without borrowing a realm title to make them respectable.

wintercity_e07_010.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_010.text: Tuan asked Yue to step backward around a marked stone while keeping her hands relaxed. She looked down too late and placed a heel against the marker. He stopped her before asking for speed. Her circuit would not improve the placement if her attention stayed fixed on her hands. She repeated the step with her eyes on the space she would need. The next attempt cleared the marker. One corrected ordinary movement did not establish that she could retreat equally well under a public challenge.

wintercity_e07_011.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_011.text: A porter practising nearby landed poorly on the pad and sat up slowly. Tuan asked about his neck and back before permitting another attempt. The porter wanted to finish the sequence, but his reported sharp pain ended the lesson for him. Another student fetched his bag while Tuan arranged ordinary clinic advice. Yue watched the lost practice interval and the unfinished sequence. The instructor did not demand a satisfying completion from someone whose body had already changed the conditions.

wintercity_e07_012.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_012.text: The remaining students continued at lower height, with the pad checked between attempts. Yue practised one ordinary seated roll after Tuan demonstrated it and confirmed the space. She used no qi, no airborne catch, and no borrowed claim of invulnerability. The motion felt awkward. It also gave her a clearer understanding of where an unplanned step might place her forearm. Tuan wanted that understanding more than an impressive fall. He had seen too many people confuse looking calm with having a safe return.

wintercity_e07_013.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_013.text: At the end of the paid interval, she returned the borrowed cloth knee cover and checked its condition with the attendant. Tuan advised practising ordinary steps on a clear level floor between lessons, without turning household furniture into obstacles. Yue wrote the advice beside the paid receipt. The yard had offered her a bounded useful ordinary lesson; she had completed part of it and observed part. It did not provide a spiritual defence against a stronger cultivator or a certificate that falling would never hurt.

wintercity_e07_014.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_014.text: In the afternoon, Yue reviewed her practice account at the inn. Qi Gathering's small circuit named established connections, not unlimited delivery. The half-unit input over four ordinary breaths remained a ceiling for the familiar permitted task, with flow no greater than one eighth per breath on the recovered route. Her reserve could be larger than that expenditure and still unable to pass faster safely. She drew two separate columns, one for stored charge and one for route flow, so the distinction would survive a tired glance.

wintercity_e07_015.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_015.text: She added a third column for useful work. Earlier measured tasks had spent a half-unit to deliver a quarter-unit result. The missing portion was not a debt she could force the apparatus to repay. A changed instrument might produce a different measured result and would need its own account. Calibration discharge also had to be subtracted before unexplained loss could be identified. Her neat page made the categories clearer; it did not make any physical cost smaller.

wintercity_e07_016.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_016.text: On Day 858, Yan showed her the portable copper-thread comparator intended for the personal rehearsal. It was separate from the coupled public rig. Its inspected grounded wick and familiar route allowed a bounded trace task after the ordinary checks. No external fuel cylinder powered its result. The thread's calibration had to be verified in the room's ambient conditions, and its sampling discharge entered in the practitioner's own account. Yue asked Luo Pei to inspect the proposed task before taking the apparatus from its shelf.

wintercity_e07_017.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_017.text: The examiner checked Yue's recovered condition and asked about any new pain, tremor, or numbness. Yue reported none, without claiming that the answer qualified a higher stage. Luo Pei compared the recorded earlier limits with the proposed lower initial setting. The first rehearsal would use less than the ceiling. Yue would stop at any changed sensation. Passing a question about symptoms could not guarantee a symptom-free task; it established the conditions under which the attempt might properly begin.

wintercity_e07_018.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_018.text: Yan placed the ordinary isolation handle within reach and checked the clear step-back space. The grounded wick was inspected for the intended discharge, not selected because it looked old and trustworthy. Luo Pei watched the calibration blank. Yue recorded the sampling cost before the personal task. The apparatus's glow belonged to the calibrated comparator, not to an external factory allocation. No room became warm from it, and no city fuel issue would be marked completed on the strength of this small personal preparation.

wintercity_e07_019.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_019.text: Yue admitted the lower trace through the recovered route over the agreed ordinary breaths. She followed the established small circuit without seeking a new vessel or another dantian. The copper thread lit briefly at the observed setting. When the examiner covered the indicator, Yue used the rehearsed stop and released into the grounded wick. She had to trust the sequence she had prepared rather than chase a visible glow. The useful result and total discharge were measured afterward, not guessed from how satisfying the attempt had felt.

wintercity_e07_020.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_020.text: The lower task delivered an eighth-unit useful indication from a quarter-unit personal input. The known sampling discharge was entered separately. Yue spent that input; it was not still in her reserve merely because the thread had gone dark. Luo Pei checked ordinary touch and movement after the safe release. The result supported this bounded application under today's conditions. It did not establish that Yue could double the flow, sustain the task through exhaustion, or apply the same numbers to an unfamiliar instrument.

wintercity_e07_021.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_021.text: Yan locked the comparator away after its final inspection. Yue walked to the ordinary clinic noticeboard on her way home, though she required no treatment. She wanted the urgent hours in her current notebook rather than rely on memory from the yard. The schedule remained the same. Preparing to seek ordinary care if needed did not call an injury into existence. It gave her a practical route that would not depend on somebody recognising her as an important cultivator at the door.

wintercity_e07_022.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_022.text: At the inn, she ate, drank ordinary water, and left the next practice interval uncharged. The task's small expenditure still belonged in the account. Replenishment required permitted gathering and refinement under the method's conditions, with recovery checked afterward; food did not become a breath-unit by being nutritious. Rest served her body and her safe practice, rather than erasing what she had spent. She closed the book before the lamp made the small print difficult.

wintercity_e07_023.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_023.text: On Day 859, her next-day check showed normal sensation and ordinary grip. She recorded that recovered result without adding a new realm. She could still copy, sew, and walk; she would not turn those ordinary activities into proof of a larger spiritual output. Luo Pei saw the record at the permitted follow-up desk. The examiner approved continued preparation for a bounded coupled application, subject to its source withdrawal and task-specific inspection. There was no independent authorization to operate the city's heat main.

wintercity_e07_024.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_024.text: Yue paid a four-copper reservation for the provisional coupled interval, subject to its posted postponement terms. She kept the source booking separate from the ordinary yard lesson, whose expired visitor interval could not be reused.

wintercity_e07_025.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_025.text: Ning had a one-morning copying job available, paid six copper for three completed hours. Yue accepted after confirming that the work involved only public replacement-map corrections and the next review date. It did not overlap the follow-up check. She copied a notice that included a route newly cleared after the drainage repair. The map became more useful because a real path had reopened. A corrected arrow was grounded in that physical change, rather than a hope that the street would be clear when somebody used it.

wintercity_e07_026.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_026.text: A petitioner at the desk asked whether he could write that the clearer notices proved the city had admitted every earlier complaint. Ning said the adopted correction established its stated notice defect and remedy. Other claims still needed their own evidence. Yue heard the answer while folding completed copies. They could value a meaningful improvement without converting it into a blanket confession. A hearing could later examine more, but today's work would not conceal the boundary by writing what the petitioner wished had already been decided.

wintercity_e07_027.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_027.text: The public desk paid six copper for Yue's completed three-hour task on Day 859. Ren's late-afternoon three-hour shift also paid six, bringing merchant wages to fifty-four through nine completed shifts. Yue checked the two receipts rather than charge both employers for one interval. She paid two for that day's ordinary meals and kept the rest in her current account. The travel purse remained thirty-two. The family dispatch still awaited distant confirmation, and the pending practice needed its own real accepted fee and source.

wintercity_e07_028.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_028.text: In the afternoon, she walked to the old city wall with the music student. His rehearsal room had changed because the main closure disrupted its first reopening interval. He found a public alternative for one short practice period and kept the private booking for another day under its actual remedy. Yue listened while he compared the useful minutes, not only the prices. A room could be cheaper and still leave too little time to unpack, tune, and work before closing.

wintercity_e07_029.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_029.text: He tried the melody they had heard from the grandmother, without using her name. The memory was imperfect. Yue could not repair it from an unopened record because she had chosen to respect the woman's refusal of recording. They sang the uncertain line twice and laughed at their disagreement. The student said he would ask again if they met her. Listening had preserved a relationship and left a gap in the melody. Both were actual consequences of the bounded permission.

wintercity_e07_030.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_030.text: Later on Day 859, Yue visited the city museum's small public display of retired heating controls. Admission was free during the posted interval. One control arm had been cut open to show a worn pivot; another remained sealed because its contents required specialist handling. A label explained why the sealed example could not be opened for visitors. Seeing an object did not entitle them to its uncertain residue, and a museum could teach a failure without making its hazard available to curious hands.

wintercity_e07_031.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_031.text: A guide described a past maintenance error using the recovered public report. The operator's name was omitted under the agreed display rule, while the procedure defect remained explicit. Yue asked whether the old control had failed before or after its approved replacement date. The guide showed the documented sequence and marked the uncertainty in one unobserved interval. The display did not need a complete villain to explain why the current inspection now checked the pivot separately.

wintercity_e07_032.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_032.text: Beside the machinery, an artist had drawn the people who maintained it. Their faces were sketches from consenting sitters, with a notice allowing each sitter to withdraw a portrait from future exhibitions. Yue liked that the exhibit made maintenance visible without claiming every worker wanted to become its emblem. One portrait space stood empty after a withdrawal. The guide had left its frame in place with a neutral note. The absence showed a choice being honoured rather than a story waiting to be filled by speculation.

wintercity_e07_033.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_033.text: A little boy asked why a stronger cultivator had not held the broken pivot together. The guide answered that the past report described the actual apparatus and people present, and no qualified replacement technique had been arranged then. A hypothetical rescue could not be entered afterward as something they ought to have received automatically. Yue thought about her prepared ordinary clinic route. Practical prevention began before the incident; a comforting imagined expert could arrive infinitely quickly only in a tale that owed nobody a real timetable.

wintercity_e07_034.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_034.text: The boy's grandmother asked whether the display might frighten him away from learning a trade. The guide said she wanted him to learn what the work required, including how to stop and ask for help. The boy wanted to draw the cut pivot. He chose a pencil from the public box and sat at the table. His grandmother approved after checking the table was outside the handling area. Curiosity remained possible inside the limit, with an ordinary drawing he could take home.

wintercity_e07_035.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_035.text: Yue left before the next group entered. At the doorway, she put her used brochure in the reuse tray because she had copied only the public report reference she needed. Another visitor picked it up. Sharing an ordinary brochure did not give either of them ownership of the retired control or its workers' histories. The museum had supplied a public explanation, and Yue carried a narrow question about inspection timing rather than the whole exhibit as a ready-made argument for a future hearing.

wintercity_e07_036.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_036.text: On Day 860, the public rig's source schedule arrived. The compatible cylinder class for the coupled task could be withdrawn only after the approved request was signed. The next reserved inspection and issue window was Day 867. The provisional Day 861 powered rehearsal therefore could not proceed. Yan would not substitute an uninspected class or borrow charge from a different paid task. Yue marked the powered attempt postponed, while retaining the ordinary orientation and personal comparator work already properly completed.

wintercity_e07_037.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_037.text: The delay cost her time and changed what she could claim at the next public demonstration. She had evidence of a lower personal indication and safe interruption under its measured conditions, not a completed coupled output. Luo Pei amended the task schedule openly. An orderly explanation could make the delay understandable; it could not make the missing Day 861 result exist. Yue asked whether the room reservation fee could remain for the new window or be returned under the stated postponement terms.

wintercity_e07_038.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_038.text: The office offered either a transfer to the approved later window or return of the unused reservation amount, with the ordinary processing charge already stated. Yue could decide according to the actual task she wanted. No fee was charged for a powered result that had not occurred. She kept the options beside the possible application scopes. A real delay had made room for choice, with money and availability attached, while keeping the missed appointment visible beside the new date in her practical calendar.

wintercity_e07_039.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_039.text: Yan brought out the uncharged coupled model so Yue could rehearse the two distinct input accounts. The personal signal would guide a permitted control; the external cylinder would supply the apparatus's larger work. Yue could not declare the cylinder's output hers, or use a large external result as proof that her own route had carried a larger safe flow. The instrument's purpose made the distinction tempting to blur. Its paperwork and independent measurements would have to keep the temptation visible.

wintercity_e07_040.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_040.text: They practised a false-indicator interruption on the uncharged model. Yue found the isolation handle correctly, then explained where the external residual measurement would be entered. The personal discharge belonged on a different line. When Yan reversed the apparatus diagram, Yue needed another pause. She made the right explanation after tracing the path. Accuracy with a pause was preferable to a quick confident error. A later inspection would still require the actual procedure under the permitted changed conditions.

wintercity_e07_041.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_041.text: Outside, Gao Shen's service manager inspected the public demonstration board. The comparison event would use separate approved stations with ranges appropriate to their qualified participants. A broad Foundation input could not be inserted casually into the small comparator Yue had used. The owner's spiritual capacity was genuinely greater, while the apparatus also required its own compatible limits. Yue asked the manager whether the audience notice showed that distinction. He said the final notice would, and she asked for the actual publication date.

wintercity_e07_042.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_042.text: The manager recognised her from Lan's receiving account and asked whether she would consider work at the factory comparison desk. Yue said she would read a concrete offer when one existed. Her controlled small task might be relevant to some duties, but it would not make her the owner of a private method or a qualified operator for every works apparatus. The conversation ended without a signature. A future job could be attractive and still need the questions she had already named.

wintercity_e07_043.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_043.text: On Day 860, Ren paid six copper after Yue completed the tenth three-hour grain shift. Sixty was now received, with four shifts still prospective. After the merchant room closed, she helped Fen prepare guest labels for a half-hour, earning one copper at the inn's copying rate. The labels kept paid late portions with their actual buyers. Yue wrote clearly and returned the master list. Seven received today came from separate completed tasks, neither carrying a rig seat or a private method right.

wintercity_e07_044.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_044.text: Wen came downstairs with a swollen thumb from a pin prick that had become irritated. She had already sought ordinary clinic advice and was resting that hand from fine stitching. Yue offered to pour tea, not heal it with a spiritual trace. Wen would delay two repairs and ask her apprentice to do another paid part of the work. The changed work would cost time and perhaps money. Calling the injury small did not eliminate the practical choices it required.

wintercity_e07_045.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_045.text: They spent the evening reading the comic songs instead of sewing. Wen preferred the line about the gardener recovering his rake. Yue now wanted to know how the missing page resolved the argument about the pot. Their book could not answer it. Mrs. Fen invented a possible ending and made them laugh. They enjoyed her invention as an invention. It did not restore the source or make her memory of a different childhood version the certified original.

wintercity_e07_046.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_046.text: On Day 861, Yue attended the planned rehearsal room without expecting a powered coupled task. The schedule amendment was posted at its door. She would practise the ordinary sequence and review her next application choice. The lower personal comparator result from Day 858 remained recorded with its recovered follow-up. It could be used within its real scope. It could not be renamed a completed factory control trial because a spectator had heard that a cultivator was rehearsing nearby.

wintercity_e07_047.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_047.text: Luo Pei asked Yue to identify the point at which her own personal reserve account stopped and the external apparatus account began. Yue answered from the connections rather than the painted colours. The examiner then pointed to a connector that was physically similar but incompatible. Yue identified the class mark before discussing a use. The ordinary correct distinction might prevent a costly future error. It did not entitle her to alter a connector until it fit or to choose a different source without inspection.

wintercity_e07_048.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_048.text: The examiner offered three possible application scopes for the later window. Yue could prepare the bounded useful signal task with independent shutdown checks, prepare a separately defined interruption study with no production-output certificate, or postpone her own coupled application and retain only the work already completed. The first two required compatible source withdrawal and their own measured results. The third supplied no new apparatus admission. None promised advancement beyond seventh stage or a victory over Gao Shen's actual greater capacity.

wintercity_e07_049.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_049.text: The useful signal study would examine whether her permitted personal input reliably produced the task's measured control result. The interruption study would examine safe stops under changed permitted indicators and identify what production claim it did not establish. Postponement would preserve money and time while leaving those particular results unavailable. Yue compared the work she wanted, the costs she could pay, and the ordinary responsibilities already on her calendar. She would have to live with a missing qualification as well as a completed one.

wintercity_application_choice.speaker: narrator
wintercity_application_choice.text: She considered the scope of the next application after asking which duty each result could support. Luo Pei distinguished a narrow future observed control demonstration from a narrow safety comparison record. Neither would be a general operator's licence. Yue could also keep the present result and decline a new funded attempt. The decision would determine whether she bought a source for her own task, what evidence she later held, and which proposed work she would still have to refuse for lack of that evidence.

choices.text: Fund the bounded useful signal study and accept its narrow output claim.
Fund the changed-indicator interruption study without a production claim.
Postpone my coupled application, recover the stated unused fee, and buy no task fuel.

wintercity_e07_051.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_051.text: The selected application was entered for its actual scope. Any fee, source reservation, or deferred attempt followed that scope's terms; the common lesson sheet retained only the work already completed. Yue would bring the resulting approval or postponement to the yard on Day 867. She would not arrive with an attractive title in place of a compatible source request. The personal comparator and the coupled rig were different tasks, and the record would keep their results separate.

wintercity_e07_052.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_052.text: On Day 862, her ordinary recovered check remained normal. She took a long walk rather than begin another powered repetition while the coupled arrangement was still pending. Snow lay in shaded edges, but the main road had dried. A market cart spilled a little cabbage when a basket cord broke. Yue helped gather the sound leaves at the seller's request, leaving the damaged ones separate. Useful ordinary work could still happen on a day when her more ambitious planned task did not.

wintercity_e07_053.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_053.text: The seller thanked her with one small cabbage after checking that she wanted it. Yue accepted and told Mrs. Fen how she had received it before asking to store it with her paid meal ingredients. The cabbage did not become a wage entry or a gift from the heat court. Its source was ordinary and its use practical. She could appreciate it without turning a modest exchange into a permanent friendship or a public endorsement that the seller had never offered.

wintercity_e07_054.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_054.text: At the bookbinding shop, the apprentice had built a little paper cover for his own song pages. He wanted Yue to see that it stayed shut without qi. She laughed with him and inspected the ordinary thread. The cover had a rough edge, and he chose to keep it because it did not catch his fingers. Their conversation was lighter than her examiner's questions and still concerned a useful object. He asked which tune she liked; she sang only the comic line she actually knew.

wintercity_e07_055.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_055.text: On the Day 862 walk back from the bookbinder, Yue passed a woman repairing a child's coat on a street bench. The woman had a broken needle beside her thread and was looking through a small tin for another. Yue offered the spare ordinary needle she had purchased, asking whether its size suited the cloth. It did. The woman offered to pay; Yue said she meant it as a gift. The offer was clear enough that neither would have to discover later that kindness had concealed a bill.

wintercity_e07_056.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_056.text: The child wanted to show Yue a paper bird inside the coat pocket. Its longer tail made it wobble on a finger, just as the market seller had warned in another conversation. Yue admired the colour without claiming to know whether this was the same bird or the same child. She knew only what stood before her now. The child made it dip twice and catch its tail on the sleeve. The mother repaired the pocket so the bird would not fall through the hole.

wintercity_e07_057.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_057.text: They spoke about the mother's work tying parcel cords at the station. She preferred short shifts while the child attended school. Yue did not ask for private pay records or enlist her in the coming service hearing. The woman had shared an ordinary description in a brief friendly exchange, not given consent for a witness statement. Yue could remember the parcel job without publishing the woman's name. Their meeting would remain useful companionship even if it never supplied evidence for another task.

wintercity_e07_058.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_058.text: On Day 862, Ren's eleventh three-hour shift paid six copper after the grain tally was checked. The merchant total reached sixty-six; three shifts remained. Yue replaced the gifted needle from her own supplies, paying one copper. Fen checked the communal needle box and found a different outstanding token. Yue's small gift had its own source and replacement expense. It did not return the missing communal needle, which still needed its holder's proper handover. The merchant wage remained ordinary money, not a test result.

wintercity_e07_059.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_059.text: Wen came down with her thumb still resting from fine stitching. She had arranged paid help for one necessary repair and delayed another with the client's agreement. The delay meant she would earn its remaining balance later. She was irritated by the hand and grateful that the assistant could take the task. Yue offered to read a comic song, and Wen chose the gardener verse again. Ordinary care had preserved work options; it had not made the swelling vanish overnight or returned the lost fine-work hours.

wintercity_e07_060.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_060.text: Before sleeping, Yue laid her practice page beside the song book. One described input, discharge, and a selected later task; the other held an imperfect tune and paper petals. She wanted both in her life. Cultivation had changed what she could attempt, but it had not replaced friendship, food, or a carefully mended pocket. The city could make ambition feel urgent. She would keep asking what was actually available tomorrow, and what she had already completed today, before letting urgency choose in her place.

wintercity_e07_061.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_061.text: In the afternoon, Ning sent the future testimony-session offer she had promised to prepare. Its date remained weeks away, and the tasks, consent conditions, and pay had not yet received final approval. Yue read it as a draft invitation. She thanked Ning for making the purpose explicit and declined to pledge every date before the final scope arrived. The hearing would concern city service practices, with its own witnesses and sources. Her closed mine-city file would not become its default evidence store.

wintercity_e07_062.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_062.text: That evening, she sorted the available practice money separately from the necessities budget. She could cover a bounded application under the approved later arrangement if she chose it; no personal reserve could pay a copper fee. She also kept the family dispatch receipt and travel purse where they would not be counted twice. A good practice plan included the ability to stop for lack of funds or recovered condition. She wanted her next task to be an honest choice rather than an unpaid obligation wearing the name of ambition.

wintercity_e07_063.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e07_063.text: On Day 863, the week closed with her selected application recorded and the source window still ahead. The ordinary orientation, lower personal indication, and next-day checks had all actually occurred. The coupled task had not. Yue left the rig's doorway after checking the Day 867 appointment, then walked toward the inn with the cabbage wrapped beside her repaired song book.
